description: Bounded Maryland licensed-center source records and provider-returned WGS84 points with immutable offline replay; not current-business or premises verification.
redirect_policy: Fixed public Maryland item and layer URLs only; reject redirects, omit credentials and never switch endpoints on failure.
retry: No automatic retries or endpoint fallback. Publisher deferral stops acquisition.
checkpoint: Await persisted initial preflight before ID inventory and a validated observation journal before each next request. Keep complete acquisition reusable independently of normalization.
idempotency: UUID-scoped immutable acquisition; offline retained-release reuse. Partial journals are inspectable, not automatically resumed or repulled.
cancellation: Abort transport and pacing, drain retention hooks and owned writes; clean only owned incomplete cancellation output and preserve uncertain publications.
retention_profile: Internal allowlisted licensed-center records, provider-returned points, unchanged public item metadata and selected layer schema; no phone/contact or home-provider categories.

scope.coordinate_basis: provider-returned point requested with outSR=4326; validate response CRS, not address geocoding accuracy
scope.identity: OBJECTID release-scoped only; no cross-release identity or deduplication claim
